I rolled back checkout-api and opened the incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` (error rate ~0.18) across all three production regions.
2. Identified `v2.3.0` as the most recent healthy production release from the deployment history.
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0`. The first attempt hit a partial failure (only `us-east` rolled back), so I retried and completed the rollout to all regions.
4. Verified the service is now healthy on `v2.3.0` in `us-east`, `us-west`, and `eu-west` (error rate ~0.002).
5. Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0002) describing the rollback. The first `create_incident` call timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid a duplicate page.
